papers.title_en: Learning to Live: A Step Toward Lifelong Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Lirong Che, Peidong Wang, Yimeng Su, Jiong Wang, Yang Chen, Wenbo Fu, Zhenyu Huang, Tiancheng Xu, Yuzhe Yang, Dongli Xie, Xu Cao, Chuang Wang, Daqi Liu, Jian Su
papers.evidence: 机器人通过持续观察、记忆和探索获得新能力
papers.tldr: 现有具身智能体往往围绕单一任务构建，难以适应任务之间及执行过程中的环境变化。LIFE框架让机器人持续观察并选择性记忆，通过流式门控发现值得响应或记录的新事件，再利用探索、蒸馏和挂载流程将解决方案转化为新能力。其塑性记忆保留图像与结构化证据，便于后续扩充索引。该工作探索了以长期经验支持具身智能持续学习的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents are usually organized around individual tasks, yet the physical world keeps changing between tasks and during execution. We introduce LIFE (Lifelong Intelligence from Experience), a framework in which a robot observes continuously, remembers selectively, and turns experience into new capabilities. RoboBeats, a family of lightweight streaming gates, tracks conditions set by the agent and discovers new events, deciding when an observation warrants a response or a memory write. Selected observations enter Plastic Memory, a flat store of images and structured records that keeps the source evidence, so new fields and indexes can be added when later questions need them. When existing tools fall short, Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) turns solutions found during problem solving into validated, reusable tools and skills. Under matched protocols, RoboBeats substantially improves condition tracking over its base models and, at the same writing budget, retains more useful evidence for memory question answering than uniform sampling. A case study of limited scale, replaying 24 hours of continuous video recorded by a real robot, illustrates how the integrated system builds memory from a day of experience and uses it to answer everyday questions. LIFE takes a step toward robots that become more familiar with their surroundings and more capable through experience: learning not only to complete tasks, but to live in the world.

papers.title_en: SceneBound: How Much Should a Streaming 3D Reconstruction Model Remember?
papers.authors: Ziming Wang, Chuyue Gong, Chutian Wang, Jingmin Zhu, Hongliang Cao, Yuheng He, Xiuyu Li
papers.evidence: 改进流式三维重建模型的记忆与关键帧选择策略
papers.tldr: 流式三维重建模型需要保存历史帧，但写入过多会占用显存，坐标状态也可能随时间漂移。SceneBound提出无需训练的记忆管理规则：只有当当前预测相机位姿与所有已存关键帧相距超过固定半径时，才写入该帧。论文还指出，在相同更新预算下均匀间隔写入可匹配多种已有门控策略，并讨论预算对状态漂移的约束。该工作为长期在线重建提供了简洁的记忆控制方案。
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction models keep past video frames in a recurrent state, fast weights from test-time training, or a key-value (KV) cache. Each written frame shifts the coordinate frame of later cameras or occupies GPU memory. Training-free rules decide what to write from a signal of the current frame. How much they write accounts for their mean accuracy: spending the update budget of a gate at uniformly spaced frames, with no signal, matches nine published gates, and the budget bounds the drift of the state wherever the writes fall. We propose SceneBound, a training-free rule that writes a frame only when its predicted camera pose lies at least a fixed radius from every stored keyframe. Its keyframe count stays within a constant factor of the covering number of the visited poses, the fewest views that keep a keyframe near every camera, so the count grows with the places visited and stays flat when the camera returns. In large scenes, SceneBound closes a submap once decoding its first frame again reveals drift. SceneBound uses one radius across four released models and three memory types. In the recurrent state of CUT3R and the KV cache of StreamVGGT, it achieves the lowest mean trajectory error among the published training-free rules we evaluate, in one pass and over nine passes of a scene, where its keyframes grow by 3% to 6%.

papers.title_en: Embodied AI for Radio Mapping: From Solo to Swarm
papers.authors: Shangjie Zhuang, Wenlihan Lu, Zhentian Zhang, Ziwei Huang, Zaichen Zhang, Rongqing Zhang, Shijian Gao
papers.evidence: 具身智能体感知环境并规划路径以协同重建无线电地图
papers.tldr: 无线电地图可支持覆盖评估、频谱管理和连接感知移动，但单个智能体的续航与机载计算能力有限，制约测量采集和地图重建。本文讨论具身智能体如何感知环境并自主调整测绘路径，前往安全且可达的位置；进一步提出群体协作思路，通过共享观测和协调成员采样扩大测绘范围。该工作将具身感知、行动规划与协同重建结合，为大规模无线环境测绘提供了方向。
papers.abstract_en: Radio maps provide spatial knowledge of wireless environments to assess coverage, manage spectrum use, and support connectivity-aware mobility. Recent advances in embodied intelligence (EI) offer a promising approach to radio map reconstruction by enabling agents to perceive the environment and autonomously adjust their survey paths toward safe, reachable locations. However, a single agent remains constrained by limited endurance and onboard computing capacity, limiting measurement collection and reconstruction performance. Swarm cooperation can support more efficient radio mapping over larger areas by sharing observations and coordinating members' sampling. This article first explores the capabilities and applications of cooperative embodied agents. A cooperative radio map reconstruction framework is then presented, together with its key enabling techniques. Case study results illustrate how scene perception supports access to informative sampling locations and how air--ground cooperation improves reconstruction through complementary measurements and mobile support. The article concludes with open challenges and future research directions for reliable and efficient embodied cooperative radio mapping in complex environments.

papers.title_en: Generalizable robotic manipulation through compositional skill reuse
papers.authors: Hao Ren, Shuohan Chen, Senyuan Mu, Ruihan Huang, Wanfeng Shang, Yajing Shen
papers.evidence: 研究机器人操作技能的组合与复用
papers.tldr: 机器人面对新任务时，单一训练好的动作技能往往难以直接适用，限制了操作能力的迁移与泛化。本文聚焦通过组合式技能复用实现可泛化的机器人操作，核心方向是将已有技能重新组合以应对不同操作情境。当前提供的信息仅包含标题与作者，未披露具体算法、实验设置或量化结果；研究主题与机器人抓取、移动及物体交互能力直接相关。
papers.abstract_en: Hao Ren, Shuohan Chen, Senyuan Mu, Ruihan Huang, Wanfeng Shang, Yajing Shen

papers.title_en: EgoMo3R: Joint Egocentric Motion and Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Chaitanya Patel, Yusuke Kato, Rin Takahira, Kazuki Kozuka, Juan Carlos Niebles, Ehsan Adeli
papers.evidence: 从第一人称视频联合重建运动和场景几何
papers.tldr: 从第一人称视频理解人体运动及周围环境，需要同时处理运动与场景几何，但现有方法往往将两者分开，并假设相机轨迹由专用惯性传感器提供。EgoMo3R提出联合优化框架，从日常单目视频同时重建三维人体运动和场景几何，并利用低层视觉几何线索。该工作将运动恢复与场景重建结合，为机器人及增强现实中的整体三维理解提供思路。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding holistic 3D human motion and the surrounding environment from egocentric video is fundamental for applications in AR/VR and robotics. Although these tasks are inherently coupled, existing methods treat them separately. In particular, egocentric motion reconstruction methods typically assume access to metric, gravity-aligned camera trajectories from specialized inertial sensors. Recovering such trajectories from monocular egocentric video remains a significant challenge due to rapid head movements and motion blur. We present EgoMo3R, a joint optimization framework that simultaneously reconstructs 3D human motion and scene geometry from casual egocentric video. It leverages the robustness of low-level visuo-geometric primitives, including monocular depth, optical flow, and point tracks, integrated with a diffusion-based human motion prior via first-order optimization. We propose an alternating optimization scheme that establishes a synergistic feedback loop: scene reconstruction provides physical grounding and trajectory conditioning for the motion prior, while the motion prior regularizes the camera trajectory and anchors the scene in a metric, gravity-aligned world frame. We evaluate EgoMo3R on the highly dynamic sequences of the EgoExo4D and Nymeria datasets and show that it outperforms specialized baselines in both 3D scene reconstruction and egocentric motion estimation.

papers.title_en: UniGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian SLAM with Enhanced Geometry and Open-Vocabulary Semantics
papers.authors: Xingyuan Ding, Sicheng Yu, Kaiyong Zhao, Hao Wang
papers.evidence: 单目SLAM联合场景几何重建、深度与位姿估计
papers.tldr: 单目语义SLAM需要从RGB观测恢复场景几何并建立语义地图，但现有高斯方法常使语义融合难以维护，且依赖深度输入或已知位姿。本文提出UniGS-SLAM，以RGB输入解耦开放词汇语义与高斯重建，同时保持二者双向交互，并借助基础模型先验提升单目深度和位姿估计。该框架面向更稳健的单目几何与语义联合建图。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular semantic SLAM aims to reconstruct scene geometry and build semantic maps from RGB observations. Existing Gaussian-based methods often attach semantic labels or features to evolving Gaussian primitives, making semantic fusion difficult to maintain and increasing reconstruction overhead. Hybrid Gaussian--voxel representations provide more stable semantic support, but often rely on RGB-D input or known poses and do not revise historical semantic evidence after geometry updates. We present UniGS-SLAM, an RGB-only framework that decouples open-vocabulary semantics from Gaussian reconstruction while preserving bidirectional interaction. Foundation priors enhance monocular depth and pose estimation, while semantic observations are fused into an independent sparse voxel map with observation provenance, enabling historical contributions to be revised as reconstruction evolves. The fused semantics further guide Gaussian filtering and local surface refinement. Experiments on Replica, ScanNet, and KITTI-360 show leading tracking, rendering, and geometric reconstruction performance among representative RGB-only methods, together with strong open-set semantic mapping on Replica and ScanNet. We also achieve a 2.37-fold reconstruction speedup over the fastest compared semantic SLAM baseline. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/UniGS-SLAM/.

papers.title_en: SCARF: A Scene-Adaptive Depth-Guided G-3DGS Encoder Accelerator with Semantic Reuse and Fused Dataflow
papers.authors: Zirui Ma, Zhihua Fan, Haibin Wu, Wenxing Li, Fulin Zhang, Dongrui Fan, Xiaochun Ye, Wenming Li
papers.evidence: 从多视图图像前馈重建三维高斯场景并优化深度搜索
papers.tldr: 深度引导的通用三维高斯编码器可从多视图图像前馈重建场景，但逐像素穷举深度搜索会带来大量冗余内存访问，先预测深度再生成高斯的串行流程也忽略局部几何连续性。SCARF利用二维特征语义相似性复用搜索结果，并通过融合数据流改进编码处理。该工作面向边缘部署加速三维重建模型，兼顾计算效率与几何结构，是前馈式三维视觉系统的直接工程改进。
papers.abstract_en: Depth-guided, cost-volume-based Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (G-3DGS) encoders reconstruct scenes as sets of Gaussian primitives directly from multi-view images without requiring per-scene optimization, thereby facilitating feed-forward novel-view synthesis on edge computing platforms. However, their shared encoder architecture presents two primary bottlenecks. First, the per-pixel depth search disregards semantic similarity within the 2D feature space, causing depth search operations to account for over 65% of memory traffic due to redundant exhaustive candidate scans. Second, the sequential pipeline of depth prediction followed by Gaussian generation neglects local 3D geometric continuity, resulting in more than 52% of generated Gaussians being redundant prior to instantiation. In this paper, we introduce SCARF, a dataflow-co-designed accelerator that aligns each bottleneck with a corresponding scene-level regularity. To mitigate the first bottleneck, Feature Similarity Depth Reuse reconceptualizes depth search as a problem of semantic locality: depth consistency is determined by affinity in feature space rather than physical address proximity. It transforms exhaustive per-pixel depth searches into anchor-centered local searches. To overcome the second bottleneck, Scene-Adaptive Early Sparsification disrupts the conventional serial depth-to-materialization boundary by probing each tile to infer local scene regularity. It then selectively activates only the minimally sufficient generation pathway, eliminating redundant Gaussian computations before primitive instantiation. On a 27.8 square millimeter 28 nm post-layout design, SCARF delivers a 2.94x geometric-mean end-to-end speedup with maximum PSNR degradation below 0.072%, 2.23 inferences per joule, and 34.5x GPU energy efficiency.

papers.title_en: UniCross3D: Unified Cross-View and Cross-Domain Diffusion for Consistent Single-Image 3D Generation
papers.authors: U-Chae Jun, Jaeeun Ko, Jiwoo Kang
papers.evidence: 从单张图像生成三维几何并强调视角一致性
papers.tldr: 从单张图像恢复细致几何与真实外观会受到遮挡、光照变化及纹理和几何纠缠的影响，已有生成方法还可能出现跨视角几何不一致和语义对齐不足。UniCross3D提出统一的跨视角、跨领域扩散框架，并通过跨视角潜变量正则化等设计改善一致性。该工作面向生成物理连贯的三维结果，可作为单图三维重建与表面生成方向的相关研究。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing detailed geometry and realistic appearance from a single RGB image is essential yet fundamentally challenging due to inherent ambiguities such as occlusion, lighting variations, and texture-geometry entanglement. While recent diffusion-based generative models have significantly improved novel view synthesis, existing approaches suffer from two critical limitations: lack of cross-view geometric consistency and insufficient cross-domain semantic alignment. To address these issues, we introduce UniCross3D, a unified cross-view and cross-domain diffusion framework designed explicitly for consistent and physically coherent 3D generation. UniCross3D features two novel contributions: (1) a cross-view latent regularization that enforces cross-view geometric consistency across synthesized viewpoints by penalizing latent variance, and (2) a cross-domain mutual information objective grounded in the physics of image formation, explicitly aligning synthesized color and normal maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniCross3D achieves significantly improved view consistency and semantic alignment over state-of-the-art methods and yields higher-fidelity reconstructions, particularly under challenging textures and ambiguous viewpoints.

papers.title_en: SPA-Q: Structure-Preserving Adaptive Post-Training Quantization for Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Jaemin Choi, Jincheol Yang, Nahyun Lim, Yun-Seong Jeong, Matti Zinke, Hyunwoo Yu, Suk-Ju Kang
papers.evidence: 保持注意力结构的单目深度估计模型量化
papers.tldr: 基于Transformer的单目深度基础模型具有较强泛化能力，但计算和存储开销较大，低比特后训练量化还会损害预测结构。SPA-Q指出独立量化查询与键不能保持二者交互形成的注意力图，且量化误差会跨层累积，并据此设计结构保持的自适应量化方法。该工作针对深度估计模型压缩中的关键问题，推动几何视觉模型更高效部署。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has advanced rapidly with the emergence of foundation models such as Depth Anything. Their transformer-based architectures provide strong generalization across diverse scenes and domains, but also incur high computational and memory cost, making efficient deployment challenging. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides an efficient and practical solution for model compression, yet low-bit PTQ remains challenging for MDE models. When applying PTQ to Depth Anything, we identify two key challenges: (i) independently minimizing the quantization error of the query and key projections fails to preserve the attention maps induced by their interaction, and (ii) quantization errors accumulate across layers, resulting in intermediate feature distribution shifts. To address these issues, we propose SPA-Q, a Structure-Preserving Adaptive PTQ framework for MDE, consisting of two main components. First, Attention-Preserving Calibration (APC) determines query and key quantization parameters by matching the full-precision attention distribution. Second, Channel-Wise Distribution Alignment (CWDA) learns channel-wise affine transformations to mitigate quantization-induced distribution shifts, and the learned parameters are absorbed into the weights after training. Experimental results show that SPA-Q consistently outperforms existing PTQ methods under 4-bit quantization, achieving an average 25.9% reduction in AbsRel and a 17.3% improvement in $δ_1$ across NYUv2 and KITTI datasets.

papers.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
papers.authors: Yifan Luo, Takafumi Matsumaru, Vibekananda Dutta, Xin He
papers.evidence: 结合高斯泼溅与扩散先验的动态场景密集重建SLAM
papers.tldr: 动态物体会破坏视觉SLAM对静态场景的假设，导致相机跟踪漂移和三维重建不稳定；简单排除动态观测又会造成被遮挡背景缺失。DPGS-SLAM提出扩散先验与来源感知的单目高斯泼溅SLAM框架，对观测来源进行管理并增强静态结构恢复。该方法面向动态视觉环境实现更稳定的相机定位和稠密场景建图，为复杂场景表面与空间重建提供了有效技术路径。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.

papers.title_en: QVR3D: Query-Guided Visual Reasoning for Training-Free 3D Grounding
papers.authors: Jung-Hao Kao, Jing-En Huang, Jia-Wei Liao, Tzuhsuan Huang, Yu-Lun Liu, Cheng-Fu Chou, Jun-Cheng Chen
papers.evidence: 在RGB-D场景中定位语言描述的三维物体
papers.tldr: 在三维场景中依据自然语言描述定位物体，需要综合语义、空间关系和多视角信息；现有免训练方法可能将有限视觉资源用于无关区域。QVR3D在RGB-D观测上利用现成基础模型，并以查询引导最大覆盖策略选择互补且相关的观测，再进行视觉推理。该框架聚焦任务相关证据，可支持具身智能体理解场景并定位目标。
papers.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding localizes objects in 3D scenes from natural language descriptions, requiring reasoning over semantics, spatial relationships, and multi-view observations. Training-free approaches avoid costly annotations but often rely on explicit scene transformation or scene-level frame selection, which may waste limited visual capacity on query-irrelevant regions. We observe that effective grounding should prioritize observations that provide evidence for the query rather than uniformly represent the entire scene. Based on this insight, we introduce QVR3D, a query-guided visual reasoning framework that operates on RGB-D observations using off-the-shelf foundation models. QVR3D combines Query-Guided Maximum Coverage (QGMC) for selecting complementary query-relevant views with Grounding Probability Estimation (GPE) that integrates instance confidence, attribute consistency, and relationship consistency. The framework supports both single- and multi-object grounding without task-specific adaptation. Experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, while QGMC also improves frame efficiency across multiple 3D vision-language tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/jwliao1209/QVR3D.

papers.title_en: SCOUT: Planning under Occlusion via Object-Centric World Model Rollouts
papers.authors: Amir Hossain Raj, Xuesu Xiao
papers.evidence: 通过物体中心世界模型推演遮挡场景中的机器人操作计划
papers.tldr: 机器人在杂乱空间操作时，遮挡会掩盖目标、障碍物几何和可通行区域，单纯反应式策略难以处理这些隐藏约束。SCOUT以物体中心表示恢复隐藏几何并建立阻挡关系和可达通道，再由语言模型提出候选动作、通过蒙特卡洛树搜索及物理推演评估。该框架将高层规划与落地执行联系起来，为遮挡环境中的机器人操作提供更系统的决策途径。
papers.abstract_en: Robots manipulating in cluttered spaces must often plan from partial views where foreground objects occlude the target, surrounding geometry, and usable free space. Reactive policies often miss these hidden constraints, while exhaustive search becomes computationally prohibitive in dense clutter. We present SCOUT, an occlusion-aware planning framework that bridges high-level deliberation with grounded physical rollouts. SCOUT leverages an object-centric scene representation to reconstruct hidden geometry and derive a relational planning state capturing blocker hierarchies and accessibility corridors. To navigate the vast action space in clutter, an LLM proposes structured action candidates which are then rigorously evaluated via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) using a learned action-conditioned world model. Evaluations on 'Reveal' and 'Placement' tasks show that SCOUT outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, embodied agents, and 3D world models, with significant gains in long-horizon tasks requiring reasoning over occluded geometry. We further validate the framework's robustness through real-world robotic manipulation in a cluttered shelf environment.

papers.title_en: MMCoT$^3$: Empowering 3D Scene Understanding with 3D-Text Interleaved Multi-Modal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.authors: Yongqi Shan, Yifan Wang, Yunzhi Zhuge, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu
papers.evidence: 直接研究点云三维场景理解与推理
papers.tldr: 点云三维场景理解需要模型进行可靠的多步推理，但现有三维大语言模型容易脱离视觉证据，难以区分相似实例并可能产生幻觉。MMCoT³提出三维信息与文本交错的多模态思维链，使推理步骤能够与场景证据互动并核验中间结论。该框架面向复杂三维场景理解，旨在提升推理的落地性和可信度。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and reasoning over 3D scenes from point clouds is essential for a broad range of AI applications. Recent 3D large language models have shown promising results, yet they still face two fundamental limitations: (i) insufficient capability for grounded multi-step reasoning in complex 3D scenes, and (ii) a text-centric inference paradigm that lacks effective interaction between textual reasoning and visual evidence. As a result, these models often fail to verify intermediate inferences, disambiguate similar object instances, and avoid hallucinations. To address these limitations, we propose MMCoT$^3$, the first 3D-Text Interleaved Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework for 3D scene understanding. The core idea is to explicitly interleave textual reasoning with task-relevant 3D evidence, enabling the model to consult scene observations throughout the reasoning process. In addition, since a textual mention in 3D scenes may correspond to multiple candidate objects, naive object-mention alignment can inject incorrect evidence and mislead subsequent reasoning. To mitigate this multi-instance ambiguity, we design an ambiguity-aware evidence aggregation mechanism that uses query-guided cross-attention to fuse candidate object tokens and inject both evidence and ambiguity cues into the reasoning process. To better equip the model with multi-step reasoning capability, we further develop PointCoT, a large-scale 3D-specific CoT instruction tuning dataset with approximately 176.2K instances spanning captioning, question answering, dialogue, and planning tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that our method consistently improves performance and achieves state-of-the-art results, validating the effectiveness of our proposed ambiguity-aware 3D-text interleaved reasoning for 3D scene understanding.

papers.title_en: Reconstruction as Spatial Evaluation: Diagnosing Cross-View Spatial Intelligence in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Junfei Wu, Qiuyue Wang, Xuhong Huang, Qihang Peng, Mingsheng Li, Jian Guan, Qiang Liu, Shu Wu, Liang Wang, Shuai Bai, Tieniu Tan
papers.evidence: 以多视图三维场景重建评估视觉语言模型的空间智能
papers.tldr: 大型视觉语言模型的空间智能要求将局部观察整合为几何一致的物理世界表示，但常见静态测试只考察孤立的方向或距离判断，交互式具身测试又混入规划、控制和仿真执行因素。本文提出RECONSPATIAL基准，以室内、桌面和户外真实多视图图像为输入，要求模型针对查询目标预测共享相机坐标系中的定向三维框。该任务直接检验跨视图空间重建能力，为诊断模型的三维理解提供评测方式。
papers.abstract_en: The spatial intelligence of large vision-language models (LVLMs) requires the ability to combine local visual observations into a geometrically consistent representation of the physical world. Many static benchmarks assess isolated spatial judgments, such as relative direction or distance, while interactive embodied evaluations combine perception with exploration, planning, control, and simulator-specific execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce RECONSPATIAL, a benchmark centered on multi-view 3D scene reconstruction across indoor, tabletop, and outdoor environments. Given real multi-view images and target-object queries, LVLMs are required to jointly predict oriented 3D bounding boxes in a shared, camera-anchored metric coordinate frame. Reconstructions are evaluated along two complementary axes: Structure for relative layout and Metric for physical scale and camera-anchored placement. Nine atomic spatial QA tasks, grouped into Geometric Perception and Spatial Relations, probe spatial capabilities involved in joint reconstruction. Offline navigation extends evaluation to path planning. Evaluation of 18 frontier LVLMs reveals a consistent gap between relative scene structure and metric reconstruction; even GPT-6-Astra scores 81.4% on Structure but only 58.7% on Metric. Tracing this gap, diagnostic analyses link atomic spatial capabilities to reconstruction quality and show that relational consistency alone does not ensure metric accuracy. Experiments with 3D map injection further separate scene construction from path planning, revealing how these geometric errors limit navigation success. Finally, spatial fine-tuning yields broad transfer across both spatial and general vision-language benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier for Urban Photogrammetric Point Cloud Segmentation
papers.authors: Chong Liu, Yonghua Lu, Zhanglin Cheng
papers.evidence: 直接涉及城市点云场景语义分割
papers.tldr: 城市摄影测量点云常按局部块处理，有限上下文使几何相似类别难以区分；正射影像虽提供大范围信息，却压缩垂直几何。ACASAC融合配准的影像与点云表示，并通过点对齐航拍区域连接整幅影像和局部点云，再以样本自适应分类器调整决策。该方案面向城市点云语义分割，兼顾全局场景上下文与局部三维结构。
papers.abstract_en: Urban photogrammetric point clouds are commonly processed as local 3D patches, limiting the context available for distinguishing geometrically similar categories. Orthographic projection of the same data yields a co-registered digital orthophoto map (DOM)/RGB-D representation that supports efficient large-context modeling but compresses vertical geometry. Existing projection--point methods mainly fuse these two representations at the feature level while retaining a classifier shared across all samples. We present the Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier (ACASAC), which complements feature fusion with decision-level adaptation. A point-aligned aerial region bridges the full aerial crop and local 3D patch. ACASAC models scene-to-local variation within the projection and the representation discrepancy between aligned 2D and 3D supports, then transfers both relations to refine the local point class representation. The refined representation, scene-level aerial context, and fixed fused-head prior jointly form a classifier for the current sample. ACASAC improves the fixed dual-representation head by 2.1 and 2.7 mIoU points on SensatUrban and UrbanBIS, respectively, and by 2.1--2.3 points across four tested encoder combinations.

papers.title_en: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Tony Tao, Jason Jingzhou Liu, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Deepak Pathak
papers.evidence: 面向实体机器人的学习型移动操作系统与策略
papers.tldr: 通用移动操作需要机器人硬件、示范数据、全身控制与策略学习协同，但这些组件各自开发时容易出现不匹配。Pixel提出全栈协同设计方案，结合低成本轮式人形机器人、遥操作和免机器人数据采集接口、统一控制器，以及融合人类与机器人示范的策略学习流程。分层学习栈进一步支持移动操作任务。该系统为具身智能研究提供了可复用的软硬件整体方案。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

papers.title_en: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
papers.authors: Yihang Liu, Yiming Chen, Mingzhe Zheng
papers.evidence: 用三维几何抽象支撑机器人场景推理与交互决策
papers.tldr: 机器人策略若在每一步都重新解释原始视觉观测，空间推理可能重复且难以保持任务结构。本文提出将常规空间推理从图像转移到文本和符号，通过校准RGB-D观测建立带证据标记的对象部件几何引用，并在动作后返回包含度量残差的简洁检查点。抽象可在决策间复用，同时局部更新场景中的数值信息，为具身智能体连接感知、推理与行动提供了轻量接口。
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.

papers.title_en: Asynchronous Robot Policies
papers.authors: Sombit Dey, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel
papers.evidence: 解耦机器人语义推理与低层动作控制
papers.tldr: 视觉语言基础模型提升了通用机器人操作能力，但其计算延迟会降低机器人在物理环境中的实时反应速度。异步机器人策略将高层语义推理与低层动作生成解耦：视觉语言模型以较低频率异步更新语义记忆，轻量控制策略则独立运行。该架构旨在兼顾复杂语义理解和快速动作响应，为具身智能系统的实时控制设计提供了新的组织方式。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling vision-language foundation models has significantly advanced generalist robot manipulation, but the increased model scale introduces computational latency that degrades real-time physical reactivity. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures execute high-level semantic reasoning and action ex- ecution sequentially within the primary control loop, creating a fundamental tension between semantic-reasoning capability and robot agility. To address this, we propose Asynchronous Robot Policy (ARP), an architectural framework that decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes operating at independent frequencies. In ARP, a high-capacity Vision-Language Model (VLM) asynchronously updates a semantic memory at low fre- quency, while a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on this semantic memory, generates robot actions at a much higher control frequency. Such a formulation, enables having a fast perception-action loop without compromising on the semantic capability. To overcome asynchronous memory staleness, ARP trains the vision-action expert on the semantic staleness and execution delay, with temporally mismatched observation across processes. On Franka manipulation tasks, ARP achieves an 18% higher success rate and 20% less time need for execution in quasi-static setups, while 3-5 times baseline performance in dynamic simulation environments. Furthermore, ARP enables operating the VLM at 10 times lower than its nominal frequency with no significant performance loss making it much more efficient than the baseline. These results highlight the architectural advantages of modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes, enabling real-world reactive deployment without sacrificing the scale of foundation models.

papers.title_en: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
papers.authors: Zhipeng Zhong, Matthew Coombes, Cunjia Liu
papers.evidence: 提出用于三维重建和深度估计的可见性参考生成与评测流程
papers.tldr: 植被丰富的户外环境缺少可靠的几何真值，完整扫描代价高，使视觉三维重建和深度估计难以公平评测。本文提出基于激光雷达的参考生成流程，复用已有多传感器定位数据中的图像、扫描和参考位姿，构造逐视角深度图及可见参考点云，并引入大深度间隔可见性分数处理累积点云的遮挡误差。该流程支持评估前馈视觉几何模型及传统SfM，为复杂户外场景建立更实用的重建基准。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation in vegetation-rich outdoor environments is limited by the scarcity of geometric ground-truth data and the cost of complete scanner surveys. We present a LiDARbased reference-generation pipeline for evaluating the zero-shot performance of feed-forward visual-geometry models alongside conventional structure-from-motion (SfM) methods. The pipeline reuses camera images, LiDAR scans, and reference poses from existing multi-sensor localization datasets to generate per-view depth maps and visible reference point clouds. To address visibility errors in accumulated LiDAR scans, we introduce the LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score (LDGVS) for point-wise visibility filtering and automatic scale selection in Hidden Point Removal(HPR). Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TartanGround show that, compared with Poisson surface reconstruction, which is an approach suited to completed scan surveys, the combined HPR and LDGVS filtering retains approximately three times the point density at comparable absolute relative error. We also apply the pipeline to the BotanicGarden dataset to systematically compare depth estimation and 3D reconstruction methods. Feedforward methods produce dense depth predictions efficiently, but their 3D reconstructions can contain duplicated structures. Conventional SfM generally produces more coherent geometry, but its reconstructions remain sparse and more prone to failure in challenging vegetated scenes. The benchmark toolkit and datasets will be released.

papers.title_en: Contact-Implicit Whole-Body Trajectory Optimization for Dynamic Humanoid Locomotion on Parameterizable Uneven Terrain
papers.authors: Roberto Mauceri, Stefano Dafarra, Giulio Romualdi, Marco Gabiccini, Daniele Pucci
papers.evidence: 研究人形机器人在不平整环境中的动态运动规划与身体交互
papers.tldr: 在人形机器人跨越台阶和斜坡等复杂地形时，预先指定接触序列会限制运动规划的适用性。本文提出接触隐式全身轨迹优化框架，联合考虑机器人动力学与运动学，以平滑曲面近似地形，并用新的接触约束描述机器人与地面的刚性作用。该方法无需预设接触顺序即可规划动态运动，将双足运动规划扩展到更一般的不平整地形。
papers.abstract_en: This letter presents a trajectory planner for humanoid robots to perform dynamic motions on complex, parameterizable terrains using a contact-implicit whole-body optimization framework. The planner generates feasible movements without predefined contact sequences, considering the robot's full dynamics and kinematics. To plan bipedal locomotion on steps, ramps, and other terrains, we propose a mathematical model to approximate ground geometry with a smooth surface. The rigid interaction between the robot and the ground is modeled via novel contact constraints, extending the domain of applicability from flat and horizontal surfaces to any arbitrary smooth surface. Effectiveness is demonstrated using nonlinear programming to plan motions on various terrain topologies. We also explore dynamic trajectory generation by embedding high-level requirements in the cost function and the initial guess. Preliminary feasibility tests were conducted over non-coplanar terrains, both in simulation and on the real robot ErgoCub.

papers.title_en: Feature Puzzles: Single-Image Supervision for Multi-View 3D-Aware Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiahao Ma, Qiang Zhang, Miaomiao Liu, David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Chuong Nguyen
papers.evidence: 研究多视角一致的三维感知分割，与场景分割及理解直接相关
papers.tldr: 跨视角识别同一场景中的物体通常需要视频或标定多视图数据，采集成本高且覆盖范围有限。本文提出Feature Puzzles，仅使用单图语义分割监督，通过裁剪和几何变换构造多视图一致的分割伪标签，并以轻量可插拔网络利用一致性图像特征。该方案旨在降低三维感知分割对多视图数据的依赖；摘要未提供具体量化结果。
papers.abstract_en: Humans can easily recognize the same objects across different viewpoints of a 3D scene, whereas teaching models such multi-view-consistent perception typically requires videos or calibrated multi-view captures, which are considerably more expensive and less diverse than large-scale monocular data.~In this paper, we introduce Feature Puzzles, a novel framework for learning multi-view-consistent segmentation using only single-image semantic segmentation supervision. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective pipeline that constructs multi-view-consistent segmentation pseudo-labels through image cropping and geometric transformations. We further introduce a lightweight, plug-and-play network that leverages the multi-view-consistent image features learned by existing pretrained 3D foundation models and the generated pseudo-labels to perform multi-view-consistent segmentation. Importantly, our flexible framework supports various types of prompts provided from one or multiple views and can be readily extended to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Under this single-image supervision, our feed-forward model achieves the best mIoU on NVOS, remains competitive on SPIn-NeRF and ScanNet++ against baselines using per-scene optimization or in-domain multi-view training, and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Visual comparisons are available on our project page: https://featurepuzzles.github.io/

papers.title_en: STARE: Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects
papers.authors: Kento Tokura, Ryosuke Korekata, Daichi Yashima, Kei Katsumata, Kanon Amemiya, Miyu Goko, Komei Sugiura
papers.evidence: 服务机器人理解场景信息并检索、搬运指定物体
papers.tldr: 服务机器人依据自由形式指令检索并搬运物体时，需要同时理解物体外观、空间关系和环境中的场景文字。本文提出场景文字感知多模态检索框架STARE，利用跨语言视觉提示增强文字识别，并关联指令中的命名实体与对应物体。研究还构建两个新基准进行评估，为机器人在真实环境中结合语言与感知完成物体检索任务提供了方法和测试资源。
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we focus on service robots that retrieve and transport everyday objects based on free-form instructions that may refer to visual features and scene text. This is challenging because it requires a multimodal understanding of the visual features and spatial relationships of objects, as well as scene text embedded in the environment. To address this, we propose Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects (STARE), which leverages visual and textual cues in response to free-form instructions. STARE introduces Crosslingual Visual Prompt to enhance scene text interpretation, and models the complex relationships between named entities in the instructions and their corresponding objects. We evaluate STARE using two novel benchmarks, GoGetIt and TextCaps-test, both of which consist of real-world indoor/outdoor images and instructions involving object manipulation and navigation. The results show that STARE outperforms all baseline methods on standard multimodal retrieval metrics. Furthermore, in physical experiments conducted under a zero-shot transfer setting, STARE achieves an overall success rate of 80%. Our project page and code are provided in the Supplementary Materials.

papers.title_en: UniLoop: Unified Loop Closure Detection from Retrieval to Geometric Verification and Relative Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Jingwen Yu, Pengyu Wang, Jin Wu, Weinan Chen, Ping Tan, Hong Zhang
papers.evidence: 几何基础模型同时支持相对相机位姿与视觉几何推断
papers.tldr: 闭环检测通常分别执行全局检索、几何验证和相对位姿估计，导致计算冗余且视觉表征彼此割裂。UniLoop复用预训练几何基础模型的层级表征：共享图像编码器生成全局描述子，跨视图解码器完成成对验证，模型原有几何预测则提供相对相机约束用于位姿图优化。实验覆盖地点识别、闭环验证和位姿估计，说明几何表征可支撑一体化视觉定位流程。
papers.abstract_en: Loop closure detection conventionally cascades separate models for global retrieval, geometric verification, and relative pose estimation, leading to redundant computation and disconnected visual representations. We propose UniLoop, a unified framework that reuses the hierarchical representations of the pretrained geometric foundation model throughout this pipeline. A shared image encoder produces features for compact global descriptors; the same features are passed to the cross-view decoder for pairwise verification; and the original geometric predictions provide relative camera constraints for pose-graph optimization. Experiments on place recognition, loop verification, and relative pose estimation show that UniLoop improves loop-closure robustness and accuracy while reducing redundant backbone computation relative to modular pipelines. UniLoop achieves the best Recall@10 on MSLS (96.6) and Pitts30k (99.3) among the compared methods, while its verification branch reaches 95.63 AP and 96.29 ROC-AUC, surpassing the existing geometric verification baselines.

papers.title_en: BudgetSplat: Budget-Controllable Generalizable Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Yuxi Hu, Jun Zhang, Wei Mao, Yuchen Rao, Friedrich Fraundorfer
papers.evidence: 前馈式多视图三维高斯表示与新视角合成
papers.tldr: 前馈式通用三维高斯泼溅可从多视图快速生成场景表示，但像素对齐方法往往产生大量冗余基元，使存储规模和渲染成本随分辨率及视图数增加。本文提出BudgetSplat，将表示压缩建模为重要性估计、空间覆盖和跨视图冗余的联合问题。一个训练模型即可支持多种输入视图数量和测试预算，无需逐预算重训或逐场景优化，为高效前馈三维重建表示提供了更灵活的控制方式。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient generalizable novel view synthesis, but existing pixel-aligned methods often generate highly redundant Gaussian primitives, causing the final representation size and rendering cost to grow rapidly with image resolution and the number of input views. We propose BudgetSplat, a budget-controllable feed-forward framework that adapts the final Gaussian representation to a user-specified preservation ratio. Rather than treating compaction as simple importance ranking, we formulate it as a joint problem of importance estimation, spatial coverage, and cross-view redundancy. A single trained model supports varying numbers of context views and multiple test-time budgets without per-budget retraining or per-scene compression. To realize this formulation, Intra-Cross Mask Supervision provides structure-, coverage-, and redundancy-aware guidance for learning Gaussian importance, while budget-conditioned feature modulation adapts Gaussian opacity and attributes to the requested preservation ratio. Coverage-Aware Budget Selection further combines patch-wise pre-selection, view-wise opacity ranking, and 3D redundancy suppression to construct compact yet spatially distributed Gaussian representations. Experiments on indoor reconstruction and cross-dataset generalization demonstrate consistent quality--size trade-offs across different input view counts and preservation ratios, substantially reducing final representation storage and rendering cost while preserving rendering quality.

papers.title_en: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
papers.authors: Qiang Wang, Jianxin Bi, Shulong Jiang, Ruiyang Si, Wenbo Huang, Kaiqi Chen, Jiaxin Li, Liyun Li, Xuanyi Li, Daquan Zhou
papers.evidence: 机器人通过真实环境探索和操作交互学习
papers.tldr: 将语言模型智能体连接到机器人执行，带来了如何通过真实物理交互持续改进能力的问题。PyRUA-REAL研究具身递归自我改进，让编码智能体把交互经验保存为持久记忆和可复用技能，并用于后续探索、代码修订与部署。研究围绕物理操作和执行反馈展开，分析智能体协作及反馈如何支持改进，为具身系统从实际经验中学习提供研究框架。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents powered by models such as GPT-6-Astra connect spatial reasoning with executable robot behavior, raising the question of how such agents can produce lasting improvements in robot capabilities from physical interaction. In this work, we study embodied recursive self-improvement (RSI) through real-world exploration, code refinement, and deployment using PyRUA-REAL, a framework in which coding agents retain interaction experience as persistent memory and reusable executable skills that inform subsequent exploration and improvement. Our empirical study places physical manipulation at the center of the improvement process, examining how agents collaborate, what kinds of execution feedback support effective code refinement, and how task specifications and previously acquired skills influence robustness and task transfer. We further investigate the efficiency and capability of the resulting programs when deployed without involving an online agent for decision-making. Across eight real-world tasks, PyRUA-REAL achieves an average success rate of 91.1%. In complementary evaluation on 42 tasks from the RoboDojo benchmark, it achieves an average success rate of 84.4%. This study provides empirical guidance for turning physical exploration into reusable robot skills that support continued improvement and robust, efficient deployment.
